policy: External comparison inputs only. Never inputs to BHSM action selection, normalization or prediction. Published editions are explicitly identified; a fit is not a raw measurement.

magnetic.name: Electron
magnetic.note: Negative moment: the magnetic moment points opposite to the spin. NIST uses a signed g factor.

magnetic.name: Muon
magnetic.note: An unstable, heavier lepton. This fixed CODATA 2022 reference is not a claim to include later muon g−2 measurements.

magnetic.name: Proton
magnetic.note: A composite particle: its magnetic moment reflects internal quark and gluon dynamics.

magnetic.name: Neutron
magnetic.note: Electrically neutral does not mean magnetically inert. The neutron has a nonzero magnetic moment.

comparisons.label: PDG 2025 world average
comparisons.convention: αs at the Z scale, MS-bar convention. The BHSM side is a historical electroweak matching screen.

comparisons.label: PDG 2025 experimental average
comparisons.convention: Higgs mass; PDG scale factor 1.4. Compared with a zeroth-order screen, not a dressed BHSM mass.

comparisons.label: NuFIT 6.0 (2024) global fit
comparisons.convention: Normal ordering; IC24 with Super-Kamiokande atmospheric data. Best fit and 1σ interval; not a raw measurement.

comparisons.label: NuFIT 6.0 (2024) global fit
comparisons.convention: Normal ordering; IC24 with Super-Kamiokande atmospheric data. Best fit and 1σ interval; not a raw measurement.

comparisons.label: NuFIT 6.0 (2024) global fit
comparisons.convention: Normal ordering; IC24 with Super-Kamiokande atmospheric data. Best fit and 1σ interval; not a raw measurement.

comparisons.uncertainty_text: Ratio of best fits; no joint uncertainty assigned
comparisons.label: Calculated from NuFIT 6.0 fit
comparisons.convention: Normal ordering, IC24 with SK: Δm²21 / Δm²31 = 7.49×10⁻⁵ / 2.513×10⁻³. Correlations are not supplied by this table.

comparisons.label: PDG 2025, neutral-B mixing extraction
comparisons.convention: |Vtd/Vts| extracted assuming the SM with lattice-QCD input; two uncertainties retained separately.

comparisons.label: PDG 2025 GUT review reference
comparisons.convention: sin²θW at mZ in the MS-bar scheme, not the on-shell or effective leptonic angle.

comparisons.label: Calculated from CODATA 2022 G_F
comparisons.convention: v = (√2 G_F)^−½; G_F = 1.1663787(6)×10⁻⁵ GeV⁻². A reference-derived scale, not a direct mass measurement.

energy_scales.label: Gravity
energy_scales.meaning: Planck energy, constructed from G, ħ and c; not an observed transition.

energy_scales.label: Electromagnetic
energy_scales.meaning: Electron rest-energy benchmark; electromagnetism has no single onset energy.

energy_scales.label: Strong
energy_scales.meaning: Z-scale comparison point for αs = 0.1180 ± 0.0009; not the onset of the strong force.

bao_note: The observed BAO feature is an excess of tracer pairs separated by roughly 150 Mpc. It is a statistical imprint of early sound waves, not a literal shell collapsing into a filament.
